hook.text: Enron's fraud couldn't have happened without banks. JPMorgan, Citibank.

buildup.text: Enron needed to hide debt to keep its stock price high.

discovery.text: JPMorgan used shell companies in the Cayman Islands called 'Mahonia' to funnel money as fake commodity trades to Enron.

twist.text: Banks paid $7.2 billion in settlements. They claimed they didn't know about the fraud.

climax.text: Enron was the fraud. Banks were the infrastructure. Without Wall Street's creative accounting.

punchline.text: $7.2 billion in fines. Banks built Enron's fraud infrastructure. They knew.

quiz.question: What role did banks play in Enron's fraud?
options: They designed financial structures to hide Enron's debt
